content.text:
I fixed the crash with a one-line change in `packages/babel-generator/src/source-map.ts`.

**Cause:** when you pass an `inputSourceMap`, the generator copies each original file's content out of it with `this._inputMap.sourcesContent[i]`. A source map doesn't have to include `sourcesContent`, and yours doesn't. So that value is `undefined`, and reading `[i]` from it throws "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '0')".

**Fix:** that line now reads `this._inputMap.sourcesContent?.[i]`, so a missing `sourcesContent` no longer throws.

I rebuilt and ran `transformSync` with an input source map that has no `sourcesContent`. It now returns a map instead of crashing. The output has `sourcesContent: [ undefined ]`, which becomes `null` if the map is written out as JSON. I didn't run the existing test suite or add a regression test.
